item.title: MISP Core `deleteSelection` Broken Access Control — Bulk Deletion of Foreign Event Reports & Sharing Groups (CVE-2026-56423)
item.description: High severity (CVSS 8.8) — web · CVE-2026-56423. Status: Weaponized — contributor-level bulk hard-delete of a foreign organizations Event Report confirmed against a real MISP core build; denied on the patched build. Affects: MISP (Malware Information Sharing Platform) Core — EventReportsController::deleteSelection and SharingGroupsController::deleteSelection. Tags: misp, misp-core, broken-access-control, cwe-862, bulk-deletion, authenticated, threat-intel-platform.
